note: Venue database: coordinates, canton and programme URL per venue. scrape=true: the scraper reads this venue's programme on every run (venues with high/medium reggae relevance); low-relevance venues keep scrape=false and are covered by the agendas and web search. Every show in shows.json must have its venue here — the show's coordinates come from here. The scraper adds new venues with coordinates (Google Maps / OpenStreetMap); if the address is unknown, the city centre is fine.

Bogen F.hint:
Read the homepage: each concert is a block containing plus the German text "Wochentag, DD.MM.YYYY | HH:MM" and "Türöffnung HH:MM" (doors). The headliner is in

as "Band Name COUNTRY" (e.g. "Bibi Vaplan CH"); support acts are in

, sometimes just "& Support"; co-headliners appear as multiple h1s in the same block; an optional

holds a tour note like "Releasetour EP & Buch". The page starts with a "Neu bestätigt" (newly confirmed) section that is NOT in date order, followed by the chronological list, so dedupe by detail-page URL (/konzerte/). Dachstock.hint: Prefer the iCal feed: each VEVENT has DTSTART in UTC (e.g. 20261205T213000Z, convert to Europe/Zurich), SUMMARY as "Event/Series name – Act1, Act2, ..." (acts after an en dash, comma separated, truncated at ~70 chars so check the event page for the full line-up), CATEGORIES with type plus genre tags (e.g. "Party,Drum and Bass", "Konzert,Rock,Dubstep,EDM"; some events like Dubtopia carry no CATEGORIES at all), LOCATION naming the room (Dachstock, Rössli, Sous le Pont, Grosse Halle at Reitschule, Neubrückstrasse 8, 3012 Bern) and URL to the detail page (/events/DD-MM-YYYY-slug). On the HTML /events page the list is in German: "FR, 16.10.2026 - 23:00" then the title, then one act per line each followed by its home town, then type/genre tags, then "Tickets" linking to https://www.petzi.ch/events/<id>/tickets (or "Sold Out"/"Anmeldung Erforderlich"). Genre tags are free text set by the venue and often missing for the dub night, so treat any event titled "Dubtopia" (series page /series/dubtopia) as dub/soundsystem regardless of tags. Raum der Reitschule; iCal: https://dachstock.ch/events.ics

Exil.hint: Bot-Schutz: curl -sL bekommt 403 («Verifying your connection», JavaScript nötig), darum scrape=false; nur per WebFetch/Browser lesbar, falls das durchkommt. Events are on the homepage grouped under lowercase German month headings ("november 2026", "märz 2027"); each row is "DD.MM.YY Wochentag" (e.g. "21.10.26 Mittwoch") plus the title and a type label "live" or "dj", with status markers "Sold Out" or "(abgesagt)" in or after the title; the title is just the headline act (support acts only on the detail page), and the row links to https://exil.club/events/{slug}. Detail pages give "DD.MM.YYYY Wochentag", "Einlass: HH:MM Uhr", "Start: HH:MM Uhr", support acts, price ("tickets: 42.-"), a description in German, genre tags as icon images whose alt text is the genre name (e.g. alt "World", "Electronic", "Rock"; Dancehall/Afrobeat/Reggaeton exist as tags), and a ticket link (seen: ticketmaster.ch; the venue's Montags series and some shows may differ). Note the venue sometimes hosts shows at other locations (title contains "im Plaza", "im Dynamo", "(Kaufleuten)"), so the location should be taken from the title/detail page. To triage cheaply, scan titles for known reggae/dub/ska acts and only open detail pages for candidates, checking the genre alt text for Dancehall/World. Blockiert oft automatische Abrufe (403) – dann überspringen und Exil-Shows via Skalender/Petzi/Eventfrog übernehmen.

Fri-Son.hint:
On /fr/programme each event is an
inside a div.views-row, wrapped in an ; the date is a element whose text is French ("Vendredi 23 octobre 2026"), followed by the doors time in field--name-field-time-doors ("22:00"); note the ISO datetime is UTC end-of-day so use the French text date (German on /de/programm) rather than converting the timestamp. Genres are explicit tags in div.genre-wrapper as Reggae (tags seen: Reggae, Roots Reggae, Roots, Dub, Steppa), and a "For fans of ..." advice line follows. Sold-out status appears in the status-wrapper. Genre-Filter auf der Programmseite (Reggae/Roots/Dub/Steppa).

Kaserne.hint:
Read the agenda from https://kaserne-basel.ch/de (German; /en gives the same list in English). Events are in chronological order, one
card per date; the date is in the add-to-calendar-button attributes startdate="2026-11-14" starttime="20:00" (doors) and the show time is in 21:00 (Doors 20:30); the card's name="…" attribute holds the act/title (e.g. "Mad Professor (Ariwa/UK)"), the subtitle "Support: Mother Dubber + Nightmanager" and the genre "Dub" are only in the embedded JSON (keys genre:"…", subtitle:"…", category:"concert"), and acts are also combined with " + " in the title (e.g. "Jimi Tenor + TinTin Patrone & Yanik Soland"). Filter concerts by class "concert-type" (and "black-type" for some concert nights) and by genre strings such as "Dub", "Reggae / Mundart", "Ska", "Dancehall"; dance/theatre/talk cards use dance-type/discourse-type. The ticket link is the seetickets.com URL on the card when sales are open, otherwise fall back to the event URL https://kaserne-basel.ch/de/events/; the room (Reithalle, Rossstall 1/2) is in the location="…" attribute.

KiFF.hint: Events are "Card Card-Event" blocks in German, grouped by month headings. Each card has a date like "Di 13. Okt" (weekday abbrev, day with period, month abbrev, no year) and a time (doors, e.g. "19:30"); the year is reliably derived from the event URL slug /programm/YYYY-MM-DD-slug (beware: a few slugs keep an old date after rescheduling, e.g. nenda 2026-03-18 shown as 18 Dez, so prefer the visible date plus month-heading context, and use the slug only for the year). Title is in h2.Card__Title as span.Act__name plus span.Act__country-code (e.g. "Sara Hebe" + "AR"); the Card__Byline holds "Support: X (CH)", "Special guests: ...", "Line-up: ..." or a tour name in «guillemets». Genre tags are NOT in the list cards but are on the detail page (e.g. "Reggae, Dancehall, Dub") along with Doors/Show times, Location (Foyer/Saal/Club), Mindestalter, Vorverkauf/Abendkasse prices; the simplest approach is to fetch the reggae/dub/dancehall/ska filter URLs and then open each detail page. Ticket link is the a.TicketLink in the card pointing to seetickets.com/ch/event/..., ticketcorner.ch or petzi.ch; sold-out events show "Ausverkauft" and no link. Schüür.hint: On /programm each event is a <section class="viz-event-list-box" itemscope itemtype="schema.org/Event"> with machine-readable <meta itemprop="startDate" content="2026-10-15T19:00"> and endDate, a visible German date "Do. 15. Okt. 2026 – 19:00" (door time) in div.viz-event-date, the title in span.viz-event-name (itemprop="name", also meta itemprop="performer"), a subtitle in span.viz-event-headline that carries support acts and loose genre words (e.g. "Open Season, Two Tone Club & BB House Band", "Support: Riders Connection", "Psychedelic Rock aus Fribourg"), and span.viz-event-genre which is only a category (Konzert, Party, Festival, Abriss, Live-Podcast), not a music genre. Detail link pattern is /programm/events/event-details/<artist>-<DD-MM-YYYY>-konzerthaus-schuur-luzern; "– AUSVERKAUFT" / "– ZUSATZKONZERT" / "– Einzige CH-Show!" are appended to titles. Ticket links go to seetickets.com/ch/event/<slug>/konzerthaus-schuur/<id>?PartnerID=116&src=web (target _blank, "Tickets" button); free parties (ground floor "EG", 22:00 start) have no ticket link and show "Gratis" on the detail page. Real genre information is only in the free-text body of the detail page, so an agent must read titles/subtitles and, when in doubt, the detail page body; detail pages give Datum "Fr. 16. Okt. 2026", Türöffnung/Beginn/Ende times, Preis CHF, and room (Saal/EG).

Sedel.hint: No genre tags; decide by act names.

Senkel.hint: Wix events widget rendered into HTML: 'Fr., 16. Okt.' then title, then '16. Okt. 2026, 19:00 – 17. Okt. 2026, 02:00' and a description, no genre tags. Reggae relevance: low — bar/club with darts, quizzes and occasional live bands.

Sentitreff.hint: Server-rendered WordPress homepage lists dated entries '13.10.2026' then title; the seasonal culture programme is a PDF linked from /kulturprogramm/, low yield. Reggae relevance: low — neighbourhood centre, but Basement Roots play an open-air in the Sentigarten some summers.

Sound of Glarus.hint: Open-air on the Zaunplatz in late August; line-up on the homepage as 'DONNERSTAG, 27.08.2026' then 'Act (CC) | stage | time', check in spring. Reggae relevance: low — Swiss pop/rock mainstream.

Sous Soul.hint: Junkerngasse 1, Berner Altstadt; Reggae/Ska-DJ-Nächte (Scorchers) und Dub-Konzerte.

Spielboden.hint: Homepage lists events server-side as '17. Oktober Title' (German date without year, chronological); Vorarlberg, 25 km from Liechtenstein. Reggae relevance: low — jazz, singer-songwriters, cabaret.

Spinnerei.hint: WordPress 'The Events Calendar' list ('24. Oktober Title', year in page header); the JSON API /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events gives structured dates. Reggae relevance: low — rock/indie, day dances, a tropical party now and then.

Studio Foce.hint: foce.ch is a Nuxt single-page app fed by a middleware API behind a Vercel security checkpoint; fall back to the season PDF on luganoeventi.ch and ticino.ch / tio.ch agenda entries mentioning 'Studio Foce'. Reggae relevance: medium — city-run venue with past sound-system nights (Riverside Sound System) and urban residencies.

Sudhaus.hint: Server-rendered list: 'DD.MM.YYYY 19:00 - 23:00 TITLE', multi-day entries like '16.10.2026 21:00 - Sa 17.10.2026 02:00'; promoter sub-pages under /lokal/events. Reggae relevance: low — rented to many promoters, so reggae shows possible but none currently.

Supermarket.hint: Server-rendered monthly list ('OKTOBER 2026'): rows 'FR 02 23H TITLE: DJ, DJ, ...', no genres. Reggae relevance: low — house/techno club.

Südpol.hint: Server-rendered (~530 KB), whole year on one page with month headings; each entry: day number, category (Konzert/Club/Theater/Tanz), title, subtitle; ?year=2027 and ?event=<slug>, 'AUSVERKAUFT' prefix, no genre tags. Reggae relevance: low — theatre, dance, jazz, club nights, indie.

Talhof.hint: Events on the homepage: 'Sa 17.10.2026' then title, 'Türöffnung' and a lowercase genre line (e.g. 'electronic · techno'). Reggae relevance: low — electronic nights, game nights.

TapTab Musikraum.hint: Server-rendered list on /programm: date 'Sa 17.10.2026' followed by title and short tags; same building as Kammgarn, aggregators sometimes list 'Kammgarn/haberhaus/taptab' together. Reggae relevance: medium — eclectic music room that has hosted sound-system and ska nights.

Teatro Paravento.hint: Server-rendered monthly calendar: day cells with 'DD/MM/YYYY' and events as '19:00: Title - type', month/year via query parameters; summer concerts are on the /il-bistrot-teatro-paravento/ page in August. Reggae relevance: low — independent theatre whose summer bistrot concerts range 'from reggae and salsa to tango, folk and jazz'.

THE HALL.hint: Server-rendered: year heading then rows 'DD. Monat YYYY Act' with status notes (verlegt/ausverkauft/abgesagt); genre filter buttons without a reggae category. Reggae relevance: low — former Samsung Hall, pop/rap/metal.

Thunfest.hint: City festival in mid-August (next 13.–15.08.2027); server-rendered one-pager with dates as '13. – 15. August 2027', line-up under 'Programm' in early summer only. Reggae relevance: low — Swiss reggae artist Dodo headlined 2026.

Treibhaus.hint: Server-rendered: entries 'FR 16 . Oktober 2026', time, room (Klub/Bar/Garten), title, subtitle; Konzert/Party filter links, '[ABGESAGT]' prefix for cancelled shows, no genre tags. Reggae relevance: low — youth culture house that occasionally books ska/reggae.

Treppenhaus.hint: Homepage is the programme grouped by month ('Oktober:'): weekday abbreviation, day number, genre label, act name and country code per entry, year implied; some markup fragments leak into the text. Reggae relevance: medium — genre-tagged weekly live shows incl. dub-leaning acts (TASHEENO); mostly rock, rap, funk.

Turnhalle im PROGR.hint: bee-flat's server-rendered homepage lists concerts as 'Mi, 14. Oktober, 20:30 Uhr PROGR Turnhalle' + tagline + artist + country without year; turnhalle.ch is offline and other Turnhalle events are on progr.ch. Reggae relevance: low — jazz, world, indie.

Undertown.hint: Short server-rendered homepage lists next events as 'Concert de X + Y' with '23 Oct' dates (no year) and 21h00; full list on petzi.ch/fr/organiser/21/, no genre tags. Reggae relevance: low — metal/rock bills.

Usine à Gaz.hint: /toute-la-saison/ is server-rendered: cards with category (Musique / Clubbing / Cirque), title and date 'DD.MM.YYYY' or 'DD.MM.YY', no fine genre. Reggae relevance: low — occasional dancehall clubbing night.

Vario Bar.hint: Template site whose 'Events' slider returned no data to curl; events are announced on social media. Reggae relevance: low — bar with a basement concert room, parties and concerts.

Volkshaus.hint: Server-rendered list grouped by month ('OKTOBER 2026'): weekday + DD.MM., event name, type label (KONZERT, COMEDY...), time, room (THEATERSAAL/WEISSER SAAL), 'AUSVERKAUFT' when sold out; no genres, tickets via the promoter. Reggae relevance: medium — big reggae tours (The Wailers 10.07.2027) use the Theatersaal.

Volkshaus Basel.hint: WordPress list: 'DD.MM.YYYY 20:00 UHR Festsaal, Volkshaus Basel' followed by title/description; ranges as 'DD.MM.YYYY-DD.MM.YYYY'. Reggae relevance: low — pop, comedy, parties in the Festsaal.

Werkk.hint: Server-rendered agenda (/agenda/konzerte/ lists only concerts): 'Sa. 17.' under a month heading, then 'Konzert | <genre tags> <Title> <price> | <time>'; werkk.ch is an unrelated site. Reggae relevance: low — youth culture venue with metal, cumbia, hip hop, occasional urban/dancehall parties.

Werkstatt.hint: Events are on the homepage inside div.events__event blocks, grouped under German month headers (span.events__month, e.g. "Oktober"); each block has a link to https://werkstattchur.ch/event/<slug>/, p.events__subtitle (organiser or tour/series name, e.g. "Präsentiert vom Folk Club Chur", "Soundsystem Tour 2023"), h3.events__title (act name split into spans) and p.events__date in German without year ("Mittwoch, 28. Oktober"), so the year must be inferred from today's date and month order. The event detail page gives the full info: a schema.org MusicEvent JSON-LD block with startDate "2026-10-28 19:00:00", doorTime, performer names and offers.url, and the visible text with "Preis: 30.- / 20.-" and a "Tickets" link that points to eventfrog.ch (ticket link pattern: eventfrog.ch/de/p/konzert/<genre>/<slug>.html, where the Eventfrog URL path contains a genre word like "folk"). Genres are not tagged on the site itself; genre must be guessed from the subtitle, description text or the Eventfrog URL. The archive page uses the same classes but dates include the year ("Mittwoch, 31. Mai 2023"). Selten Reggae; nur bei Treffern aufnehmen.

Wisa Bar.hint: Homepage lists shows server-rendered: '17.10.2026 <Act> (CH) Location: Club »Mehr Infos...'. Reggae relevance: low — rock/tribute music bar.

X-TRA.hint: Limmatstrasse 118. Programm auf /de/programm/ (server-gerendert, Datum + Uhrzeit pro Event). Selten Reggae – nur bei Treffern aufnehmen.

Z7.hint: Konzertfabrik Z7: WordPress homepage lists all upcoming events as /event/<slug>-YYYY/ links with 'Mi. 5. Oktober 2026' dates; site search ?s=reggae is server-rendered, /konzerte and /events are 404. Reggae relevance: medium — mostly rock/metal, but reggae legends (The Wailers) at the Summer Nights open air.

ZAK.hint: Zentrum aktueller Kultur: homepage programme 'DD.MM.YYYY | Title | subtitle (Support: ...)'. Reggae relevance: low — blues nights, metal, Latin night, parties.

Zentralwäscherei.hint: Homepage is a minimal teaser and /programm is 404; programme is published on Instagram, try /events or /kalender before skipping. Reggae relevance: unknown — alternative cultural centre with concerts and parties.

ZeughausKultur.hint: Homepage shows the next 5 events as 'DD.MM.YYYY' + title + type ('Konzert'); full list at /de/gesamtes-programm, German-language. Reggae relevance: low — Upper Valais cultural centre, jazz/pop/readings.
